meta.title: Re-open closed line items with a new duration

steps.note: Open the prepared serial-bidding auction with at least one ended line item.
Verify the reopen action is offered for the prepared event state.

args.goal: in the Reopen Line Items drawer, enter the requested new duration for each expired line item, select the line item or items to reopen, click Re-Open, and stop when the selected items are shown active for bidding again

steps.note: Perform and verify the drawer workflow, including duration entry, selection, confirmation, and the resulting active bidding state.
Confirm the resulting screen has no error, crash, or invalid rendering after reopening.
